Subject: POC kickoff: hands-on session & sample data prep

Hi Dev,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We have two goals for the kickoff session: run through our prompt set and routing logic, and run a couple of light load tests with representative payloads.

Can we schedule a 90-minute working session the week of June 22? We're flexible on Tuesday/Wednesday mornings PT. Also: we have internal restrictions on PII so before the session we'd like guidance on redaction and a preferred format for the sample payloads. Priya will be assembling a small evaluation set (50–100 prompts) and some multi-turn chat transcripts.

Two asks to start:
- Confirm a couple of proposed times for the workshop (90m)
- Share a short checklist with redaction guidance and required fields so our SREs can export the test payloads correctly

I'll attach a brief one-pager (internal) with the scope. If you need a signed NDA for payload transfer let me know.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, SaaSCo
(alex.johnson@saasco.com)

Hi Alex,

Great — excited to get started. We can run the workshop week of June 22. How about:
- Tue 23 Jun, 9:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed 24 Jun, 10:00–11:30 AM PT

Marissa (CC) will lead the session; she'll cover prompt engineering checks and routing config. I'll handle the load-test plan and data ingestion steps.

Attached is a short checklist and a redaction template. Key points:
- Remove direct PII (emails, phone numbers, SSNs). Replace with consistent placeholders: <REDACTED_EMAIL>, <REDACTED_PHONE>.
- Keep message metadata (timestamp, sender role) where possible — that helps routing tests.
- Provide at least 50 prompts with expected-outputs where feasible; include 10 edge-case prompts (long context, non-English).

We don't need an NDA for redacted test payloads; if you want to transfer production data we can go through legal (we can flag that in the contract).

Attachments: agenda_poc_workshop.pdf (pdf stub), sample_payload_template.csv (csv stub)

If the times above work I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + workspace links.

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
